## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Jīnguāngwáng tóngzǐ jīng* (T548) is a one-fascicle Sòng sūtra by Fǎxián 法賢 ([法賢](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%B3%A2)). The protagonist *Jīnguāngwáng tóngzǐ* 金光王童子 ("Boy Golden-Light-King") is a child-bodhisattva.

**Abstract**

A short Mahāyāna text in the child-bodhisattva genre, paralleling [KR6i0177](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0177) *Jīnyào tóngzǐ jīng*. Translation dated to Fǎxián's post-987 productive period (989–1000 CE).
